hooks.name: kompile-progress
hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); TN=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_name // \"unknown\""); SHORT=${TN#mcp_kompile_}; PARAMS=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -rc ".tool_input // {}" | head -c 120); echo "$(($(date +%s%N)/1000000))" > /tmp/.kompile_hook_ts_5fbbee77; echo >&2 "[kompile] $SHORT | $PARAMS"'

hooks.name: kompile-timing
hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); TN=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_name // \"unknown\""); SHORT=${TN#mcp_kompile_}; END=$(($(date +%s%N)/1000000)); START=$(cat /tmp/.kompile_hook_ts_5fbbee77 2>/dev/null || echo $END); MS=$((END - START)); if [ $MS -gt 1000 ]; then FMT="$((MS/1000)).$((MS%1000/100))s"; else FMT="${MS}ms"; fi; echo >&2 "[kompile] $SHORT done ($FMT)"'
